events.outcome: Current One NZ terms make Prepay credit expire 360 days after top-up and the service inactive with number loss if no new credit is added. Minimum logged-in website/app top-up is NZD10. Physical Prepay activation requires One NZ mobile coverage; China is a current Prepay roaming destination, while service-specific OTP reliability is not guaranteed.

data.acquisitionSummary: One NZ currently offers Prepay Pay & Go via physical SIM or eSIM. Ordinary Prepay activation requires the handset to be within One NZ mobile coverage; current community evidence discusses long-term eSIM/top-up use but does not remove the NZ-first activation constraint.

keep.action: Add at least NZD10 credit through the logged-in One NZ website or My One NZ app before 360 days since the last top-up. If no credit is added for 360 days, the Prepay service becomes inactive and the number is lost/recycled.

data.chinaActivation: Ordinary Prepay initial activation requires One NZ mobile coverage, so China-first activation is not treated as supported. A user can manage/top up an already activated service remotely.
data.kyc: No universal passport/residence KYC requirement was established from the reviewed standard Prepay materials; this review does not infer an exemption beyond those pages.
data.payment: Current website/app top-up supports credit/debit cards and other methods. Community reports include successful overseas card top-ups, but foreign-card execution remains operational evidence rather than a provider guarantee.
data.wifiCalling: Official Prepay roaming guidance supports WiFi Calling overseas; 2026 community users report WiFi Calling use in China.
data.roamingSms: China is explicitly listed as a current Prepay roaming destination. Carrier roaming/TXT availability is established; third-party OTP success is not guaranteed.
data.refund: A 2025 expiry incident documents discretionary one-off credit restoration after expiry, not a guaranteed recovery policy.
data.tariffSummary: Pay & Go is current. Minimum logged-in website/app top-up is NZD10; top-up credit expires after 360 days and the number is deactivated/recycled if not topped up. China is a current Prepay roaming destination.
guideSteps: Acquire and activate the ordinary Prepay service while within One NZ mobile coverage.
Top up at least NZD10 before 360 days from the prior top-up.
Treat China roaming availability and WiFi Calling as carrier capabilities, not a guarantee of every third-party OTP.
